title: Aatha Un Koyilile
desc: Marudhu works for Kasturi, who is engaged to Durai. Kasturi dislikes Durai's habits and falls for Marudhu. Although Kasturi remains firm to persuade Marudhu, he is reluctant to return her affection.

title: Bhavani
desc: Bhavani, a beautiful and kind woman, gets married to Periyadurai and gets pregnant. However, she soon learns that her husband is a womaniser and sets out to abort her unborn child.

title: Maraivaasi
desc: A billionaire's son returns after his father's death and joins the company as a regular employee in order to nab the people responsible for his father's murder.

title: Ennamma Kannu
desc: Kaasi, a womaniser, tries to woo Gayatri, a young woman, but she thwarts his advances. However, when her fiancé deserts her on the day of her wedding, Kaasi offers her refuge.

title: Kottai Mariamman
desc: Two greedy men try to steal the golden eye petals of Kottai Mariamman's idol. However, their wives, who are devotees, try to save them from the deity's wrath.
